boundary: GMUT remains a typed scalar-tensor and EFT research-model family; THOS remains represented; Freed ID remains synthetic and nonproduction; CBR, veterinary, biosecurity, legal, cultural, affected-party, and Māori concepts remain under competent, affected-party, and Māori authority. No empirical confirmation, Theory of Everything, AGI or ASI, consciousness, personhood, deployment, privacy-complete, exhaustive-security, independent-reproduction, accessibility-complete, professional, emergency, public-health, proof or canon, or Stage 20 claim is made.

proposals.hypothesis: An append-only ledger can refuse stale-revision writes and separate a bounded conflict rebase from silent lost-update promotion.
proposals.mission_surface: expected revision, observed revision, compare-and-swap, read set, proposed write set, lost update, conflict receipt, bounded rebase, evidence credit, and side-effect refusal
proposals.novelty_against_430_frozen_proposals: Earlier Method Flow proposals cover retries, checkpoints, leases, cancellation, partial output, and idempotency; none makes compare-and-swap revision conflict and lost-update evidence credit the central surface.
proposals.null_or_failure: A stale expected revision writes, a conflict is hidden, a rebase changes protected intent, partial output receives completion credit, or an external side effect is retried automatically.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the write, preserve both revisions and the conflict, re-read the bounded owner state, and require fresh authority for any external side effect.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Synthetic revision traces must reject stale writes, hidden conflicts, write-set drift, unbounded rebases, partial-output promotion, and automatic external side effects while retaining both versions.
proposals.title: Method Flow compare-and-swap revision, lost-update, conflict-rebase, and evidence-credit ledger

proposals.hypothesis: A typed symbolic tribunal can check Peierls-bracket obligations and causal support without asserting that a physical GMUT observable algebra or quantization is established.
proposals.mission_surface: linearized Euler-Lagrange operator, advanced and retarded Green operators, causal propagator, support, functional derivative, gauge invariance, antisymmetry, Jacobi scope, units, and observable algebra
proposals.novelty_against_430_frozen_proposals: The frozen chain covers covariant phase space, BRST, Hadamard states, Schwinger-Keldysh contours, and propagators; no prior proposal centers the Peierls advanced-minus-retarded bracket and gauge-observable support obligations.
proposals.null_or_failure: Advanced and retarded support is swapped, the Green operator is used outside its domain, a gauge-variant functional is promoted, antisymmetry or units drift, or a symbolic bracket becomes physical proof.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the counterexample, mark the bracket unavailable or incomplete, restore explicit domain and gauge assumptions, and make no force, prediction, likelihood, constraint, quantization, or Theory-of-Everything claim.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Positive and negative fixtures must type the operator, Green functions, causal support, functional derivatives, gauge scope, antisymmetry, Jacobi assumptions, units, and nonpromotion boundary.
proposals.title: GMUT Peierls bracket, advanced-retarded support, and gauge-observable obligation tribunal

proposals.hypothesis: A zero-row adapter can enumerate Rubin DP1 provenance and known limitations while refusing to treat commissioning catalogs or citations as a GMUT weak-lensing dataset or likelihood.

proposals.null_or_failure: The phase accesses a protected account, downloads a row, treats best-effort shape columns as calibrated shear, ignores known issues, fabricates covariance, evaluates a likelihood, or emits a force or constraint.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop before access or fit, retain the zero-row receipt, and require separately authorized data access, a frozen product snapshot, calibration and selection treatment, covariance, likelihood, uncertainty analysis, and independent review.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: The receipt must preserve zero account use, zero downloads, zero real rows, zero shear estimates, zero likelihoods, zero fits, zero constraints, and zero empirical GMUT claims.
proposals.title: GMUT Rubin DP1 object-shape, calibration-provenance, and shear-readiness zero-row protocol
